map.基于定期定额投资模型：各期投入按预期年化增长至期末并累加得总资产；与一次性投入对: Based on the periodic fixed-amount model: each contribution grows to the end at the expected annual rate and accumulates into total assets; compared with lump-sum, for fund DCA planning (no market volatility).

map.每月固定金额买基金：价低时买得多、价高时买得少，长期摊平持仓成本。如每月投 10: Buy a fund with a fixed monthly amount: more units when prices are low, fewer when high, smoothing holding cost over time. E.g. investing 1,000 monthly, if the market falls then rises, the average cost is below the simple average.
map.震荡市定投常优于一次性（避免买在山顶）；单边上涨市一次性更优。定投核心是消除择时: In choppy markets DCA often beats lump-sum (avoids buying at the top); in a one-way rising market lump-sum is better. DCA's core is removing timing anxiety and disciplined saving.
map.不一定。定投降低波动但不改方向，长期下跌市仍会亏损；它的优势是在波动中摊低成本、: Not necessarily. DCA reduces volatility but not direction; a long-term falling market still loses money; its advantage is lowering cost amid volatility and forced saving, suited to markets with a long-term upward expectation.
map.为什么跌时定投更好？: Why is DCA better when falling?
map.固定金额在低价买到更多份额，反弹时这些低价份额升值更快，拉低整体成本——即「微笑: A fixed amount buys more units at low prices; when it rebounds these low-price units appreciate faster, lowering overall cost — the 'smile curve' effect.
